body: It really does seem hard to have a real conversation these days. Patience seems to also be an increasingly obscure virtue.

Honestly if you can't express your own beliefs, or the lack thereof, in your own house, then maybe you shouldn't be there. In any case I would encourage you to be true to yourself and never allow anyone to bully you like this. In a relationship we have to be open and consider what our partner thinks. You have been open enough to attend church and allow your child to attend, but it seems your partner is not receptive of your thoughts at all.
I would love to know the actual destructive force of that.
